description: Send an email to a COLLEAGUE in this tenant — e.g. a price list or an offer PDF to the employee who asked for it, for approval. Recipient: to_user_id (see list_tenant_users; a numeric Pipedrive user id such as a deal owner is resolved via its email) and/or to_address; the address must be that person's login address or one of their connected mailboxes, anything else is refused. Customers are NOT reachable here — for them use send_email / send_draft_email (lead, consent check). No lead needed. Optional attachments: document_ids (e.g. from get_abaninja_quote_pdf), attachment_mode 'link' (default) or 'file'. Sends for real, from the tenant's mailbox. Called by an AGENT: NO internal status or request mails — a mail WITHOUT attachments is refused (put the request/info as create_todo on the responsible person's list instead; the todo is the channel and replies happen there), and with attachments only what the person should check or approve (e.g. a report PDF «… zur Freigabe»), never a pure status («… importiert/blockiert/erledigt»). Exception: a human explicitly asked for this mail — pass auf_wunsch_von with that person (name, user_id or address; recorded in the mail and the tool log). Also for agents: a second internal mail to the same person within 24 h with the same DN or (almost) the same subject is NOT sent — the result says dublette:true (trotzdem:true sends anyway).

attachment_mode.description: How documents are attached: link (default) or file

auf_wunsch_von.description: Agents only: the person of this tenant (name, user_id or address) who EXPLICITLY asked for this mail. Without it an agent cannot send internal mails without attachments or pure status mails — use create_todo instead.

trotzdem.description: Agents only: send even if the same person got an internal mail with the same DN or (almost) the same subject in the last 24 h — otherwise nothing is sent and dublette:true is returned.

name: send_team_email
